    Ángela Torres - NO ME OLVIDES (2025)
    Music / Pop / Latin | FLAC 16-Bit |
    "NO ME OLVIDES" is the highly anticipated recording project from the talented Argentine singer and actress Ángela Torres. In this album, Ángela consolidates her musical and artistic maturity, offering a collection of songs that navigate modern pop with urban and electronic influences.
    Through its 11 tracks, the record explores themes of love, heartbreak, empowerment, and the intensity of contemporary relationships. With impeccable production and catchy melodies, tracks like "Luz Roja", "FRIKI", and the title track demonstrate Ángela's vocal versatility, delivering fresh, intimate, and highly addictive material for the dance floor.
